summary: The agent implemented a substantial seedable-lazy feature and preserved all baseline behavior, but the hidden suite could not compile because generated collection hybrids lacked the normal varargs with-method overload. The generated ImmutableSeedableLazyModel exposed only withTags(Iterable<String>), while the test and established generator API use withTags(String...).
quick_failure_summary: New tests failed at compilation because the generated collection hybrid omitted the varargs withTags(String...) overload.

details.reasoning: The implementation compiles and passes the 326 baseline tests, but its special hybrid branch in generateCopyMethods emits only one method using constructorAcceptType. For a List<String> hybrid this becomes withTags(Iterable<String>), suppressing the ordinary collection branch that generates both String... and Iterable<String> overloads. The hidden test calls withTags("a", "b"), so test compilation fails before any of the 13 new tests can execute. This is a structural generated-API/signature integration defect rather than a syntax error or verifier problem.
details.secondary_factors: The agent added broad focused coverage but did not test collection hybrid with-method overload parity; its collection coverage focused on builder mutators and iterable usage.

problem_assessment.notes: The prompt is unusually detailed and the task requires coordinated metadata, immutable, Modifiable, copy, serialization, and diagnostic changes. Expecting generated hybrid with-methods to retain the established collection overloads is reasonably inferable from the explicit with-method requirement and the existing generator template, which already emits both varargs and Iterable overloads for ordinary collection attributes. The reference solution demonstrates the task is solvable.

evidence: JUnit reports 326/326 baseline tests passing and the wrapper reports baseline_passed=True.
The new-test Maven compilation identifies one concrete signature mismatch: withTags requires Iterable<String> but was called with String,String.
The existing Immutables.generator ordinary collection branch emits both a varargs with-method and an Iterable with-method, while the agent's new hybrid branch bypasses that logic.

The trajectory shows one missing apply_patch command on PATH, but the agent immediately found an alternative, completed the implementation, and successfully ran its focused and broad Maven suites; this did not materially block the solve.
environment_assessment.finding: No meaningful external blocker was found; the verifier exposed a deterministic missing generated API overload in the submitted implementation.
